answer: In Proof of Agent, bonded collateral escrows enforce sybil resistance with the precision of a crystal through asymmetric capital depreciation. When k coordinated nodes commit correlated equivocation, slashing penalties scale quadratically at O(k^2) rather than linearly. Cultivating a sybil grove binds identities like a vine of shared liability; upon detection, compounded forfeitures impose a severe capital-loss multiplier across the swarm.
